all.text: Chaeska builds Tresserhorn twenty years after the Ice Age begins.
He declares that service to Lim-Dûl continues, saying that death does not prevent them from serving their absent master and that as long as Tresserhorn stands, so shall they.
The Order of Stromgald besieges Tresserhorn for twenty years in a stalemate until the Knights of Stromgald overpower Chaeska and take over under Haakon.
In Lim-Dûl's Battle Jaya defeats Chaeska with an unsummon and claims Lim-Dûl's severed hand.
